map.泵/风机选型轴功率与电机功率估算 使用指南: Pump / Fan Selection Shaft Power and Motor Power Estimation User Guide
map.轴功率=流量(m³/h)×扬程(m)×9.81÷(3600×效率0.7)（kW）: Shaft power = flow (m³/h) × head (m) × 9.81 ÷ (3600 × efficiency 0.7) (kW); recommended motor power = ceil(shaft power × 1.2) (a 1.2x margin). Select rated flow/head with a further 1.1x margin.
map.按流量、扬程/压力计算泵或风机轴功率: Compute pump or fan shaft power from flow rate and head/pressure
map.按 1.2 倍轴功率向上取整选配电机: Round the motor up from 1.2x the shaft power when selecting
map.输出效率取值与功率余量: Output the efficiency value and power margin
map.按介质类型提示材质与密封要求: Prompt material and sealing requirements by medium type
map.流体设备选型：按流量、扬程/压力算轴功率并选电机: Fluid equipment selection: compute shaft power from flow and head/pressure and choose a motor
map.余量评估：电机按 1.2 倍轴功率向上取整: Margin assessment: round the motor up from 1.2x the shaft power
map.材料提示：高温/腐蚀/食品环境对应不同材质与密封: Material prompt: high temperature / corrosive / food environments call for different materials and sealing
map.输入流量与扬程（或风压）: Enter flow rate and head (or air pressure)
map.点击计算，读取轴功率与推荐电机功率: Click calculate to read the shaft power and recommended motor power
map.按介质特性选择材质与密封形式: Choose material and sealing form by medium characteristics
map.效率 0.7 为水泵典型估算值，实际随泵型与工况变化，须按样本效率曲线: An efficiency of 0.7 is a typical pump estimate; in reality it varies with pump type and operating point, so use the sample efficiency curve
map.电机按 1.2 倍轴功率留余量，以应对启动与工况波动: Leave a 1.2x margin on the motor against shaft power to absorb start-up and operating fluctuations
map.介质重度/黏度偏离清水时轴功率还会升高，余量应更大: When medium density/viscosity deviates from water the shaft power rises further, so the margin should be larger
map.高温/腐蚀/食品环境须选对应材质与密封形式: High-temperature, corrosive and food environments require the matching material and sealing form
map.为水泵典型总效率估算值；实际随泵型、工况点变化（好的可达0.8+），取错会偏差电: A typical total-efficiency estimate for pumps; in reality it varies with pump type and operating point (good units reach 0.8+). Choosing wrong biases the motor power, so use the sample efficiency curve.
map.建议留余量应对启动与工况波动，避免电机长期满负荷发热；介质重度/黏度偏离清水时轴: Leave a margin for start-up and operating fluctuations to avoid the motor running hot at full load for long periods; when medium density/viscosity deviates from water the shaft power rises further, so the margin should be larger.
